
---
title: "Autocovariance Function"
tags: [time-series, dependence]
categories: [theory]
---

## Definition

For a weakly stationary series,


$$\gamma(h) = \text{Cov}(x_{t+h}, x_t)$$


with variance $\gamma(0)$.

## Properties

- Symmetric: $\gamma(h) = \gamma(-h)$
- Maximized at $h = 0$
- Non-negative definite

## Sample estimator


$$\hat{\gamma}(h) = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n-h} (x_{t+h}-\bar{x})(x_t-\bar{x})$$


## Python example

```python
import numpy as np

def autocov(x, h):
    xbar = x.mean()
    return np.mean((x[h:] - xbar) * (x[:-h] - xbar))
```
